$comment: Supplementary authoring schema. Odin additionally checks exact integer token types, UTF-8 byte lengths, graph references, geometry, confined filesystem paths, dependency bytes and transaction invariants.

oneOf.$comment: Integer bounds and structure are mirrored by shared/content. Cross-document identities, references, and ordered line-beat projection are checked by the Odin graph validator. Text is bounded to 4096 UTF-8 bytes there.
